pages.text: The Constructor in Refined Storage 2 is a versatile block that places items or fluids from your storage network into the world with enhanced precision and reliability. It requires an unobstructed space in front to function, and can place blocks or drop items as needed with improved accuracy. With a Stack Upgrade, it can drop entire stacks at once with better efficiency, making it ideal for large-scale item placement tasks. RS2 features improved placement control and better mod compatibility.
